name: Starwarden’s Folly
image_style: A striking 16:10 landscape desktop artwork in hand-painted cel-vinyl animation backgrounds combined with dry pastel, translucent airbrush haze, and subtle screenprint grain. The mood is wistful, nocturnal, archival, and affectionately deadpan: a believable historical world rendered with quiet cinematic gravity, interrupted by Space Ghost’s completely serious presence. Use deep ink-blue, smoked plum, weathered ivory, muted copper, sea-glass teal, and restrained signal red. Preserve broad low-detail negative space along the upper edge and a calm widget-friendly shadow region; concentrate tactile detail below. No lettering, logos, watermark, frame, or interface elements.
scene: Exactly one striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper, preferably 2560x1600, set inside a historically grounded nineteenth-century maritime customs archive at night. Tall timber shelves, rolled nautical charts without readable marks, brass seal presses, ledger boxes, rain-streaked windows, a harbor lantern, and distant masts establish the setting with documentary precision. In the lower-right, Space Ghost is unmistakable in his muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, and red power bands, standing rigidly behind a small clerk’s desk while solemnly stamping a single enormous blank customs seal onto an empty sheet. His cape is carefully tucked beneath the desk to avoid disturbing the papers. Sleepy clerks continue their work with restrained bewilderment; the humor comes only from his misplaced bureaucratic authority. Keep the upper third dark, quiet, and spacious, with a calm shadowed lower-left region for widgets. No sacred figures, devotional attributes, worship, text, lettering, logos, UI, watermark, or frame.
